target.name: VAmPI
target.label_scope: Labels are for the specific authorization test case, not a claim that an endpoint has no other vulnerability. A documented vulnerable case can have evaluation_status=not_tested when Charon's deterministic replay cannot exercise that vulnerability class.

counting.positive_rule: A case is positive only for the class or classes in expected_owasp_classes.
counting.negative_rule: For each tested vulnerable or not_vulnerable case, every evaluation class not listed in expected_owasp_classes is a negative. A finding of that class on a negative case is a false positive, including a wrong-class finding on a case vulnerable to a different class.
counting.deduplication: Multiple findings of the same class for one case (for example, one per replay identity) count once. Inconclusive and not_tested cases are excluded from measured metrics.
counting.ratios: Precision and recall are exact fractions; a zero denominator is N/A.
